input.quote: (b) Licensee agrees to allow an independent Certified Public Accountant or other Audit Professional, (selected by mutual agreement) to audit and analyze appropriate accounting records to ensure compliance with all terms of this Agreement. Any such audit shall be permitted by Licensee within 30 days of Licensee's receipt of a written request of Licensor.
input.rationale: The only audit right binding us is Article V(IV)(b) (p0073), supported by the cost-allocation sentence at p0064. Several elements already meet or beat the preferred position: the audit is performed by an independent CPA/Audit Professional selected by mutual agreement, is limited to "appropriate accounting records" (no access to our systems), requires a written request, and cost sits with Licensor unless a discrepancy over 5% is found. However, the clause contains no frequency limit at all — Licensor may demand an audit as often as it likes, and we must permit each one within 30 days. Unlimited audits fail even the fallback (once per year) and sit in walk-away territory, so we have inserted a once-per-twelve-months cap, plus business-hours and confidentiality conditions, as the minimal edit to reach the preferred position. The absence of an express 30-day advance notice period is a lesser point noted rather than separately flagged, since a written request plus the 30-day window gives adequate lead time.

ops.oldText: Any such audit shall be permitted by Licensee within 30 days of Licensee's receipt of a written request of Licensor.
ops.newText: Any such audit shall be permitted by Licensee within 30 days of Licensee's receipt of a written request of Licensor, provided that Licensor shall not request more than one (1) such audit in any twelve (12) month period, and each such audit shall be conducted during Licensee's normal business hours and subject to the confidentiality obligations of this Agreement.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a once-per-twelve-months cap, business-hours limitation and confidentiality condition on the audit right, as the clause is currently unlimited in frequency; our playbook permits audits no more than once per 12 months on written notice. The existing independent-auditor selection and Licensor-borne cost (subject to a 5% discrepancy) work for us and are unchanged.
proposal.summary: Cap usage audits at once per 12 months, during business hours and subject to confidentiality.
